030package dev.visdb.seesaw.decorators;
031
032import javax.swing.JComponent;
033
034import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsComponent;
035
036import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
037
038/**
039 * Used for both Decorator and TextDecorator.
040 */
041public abstract class BaseAnyDecorator implements AnyDecorator {
042  private SsComponent ssComponent;
043
044  /**
045   * Install this decorator into the component. Installs listeners
046   * @param component the component
047   */
048  @Override
049  public void install(SsComponent component) {
050    if (this.ssComponent != null)
051      throw new IllegalStateException(sf("'%s' allready installed in '%s'",
052                                         this.getClass().getSimpleName(),
053                                         ssComponent.getClass().getSimpleName()));
054    this.ssComponent = component;
055  }
056
057  /** Remove decorator/listeners from component. */
058  @Override
059  public void uninstall() {
060    this.ssComponent = null;
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Return the SsComponent associated with this decorator.
065   *
066   * @return the component
067   */
068  @Override
069  public final SsComponent getSsComponent() {
070    return ssComponent;
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Convenience method to get the SsComponent cast as a JComponent.
075   *
076   * @return the SsComponent as a JComponent
077   */
078  protected final JComponent jComp() {
079    return (JComponent) getSsComponent();
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * Return the JComponent that gets decorated and TextDecorated.
084   * It may not be the same as whats returned by {@link #getSsComponent() }.
085   *
086   * @return the JComponent
087   */
088  protected final JComponent decoComp() {
089    return getSsComponent().getDecorateTarget();
090  }
091}
